purpose.microphone: Autoradio hears you when Voice is on, so you can talk to the radio, and records your voice when you tap Take, or when you teach it your voice. Speech becomes text on this phone. A take is uploaded only if you publish it.
purpose.speech: Autoradio turns what you say into text on this phone, to understand your request.
app.signin.intro: Sign in with a passkey, or create an account. There is no password. A new account first checks your email address with a code we send.
app.signin.consent: By creating an account you confirm you are 16 or older and agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms. What you ask the radio is sent to outside AI companies, which during the beta may use it to train their models.
app.signin.codesent: We emailed you an 8-digit code. Type it here and tap Create account. If this email already has an account, no code will come: we emailed a recovery link instead. Open it on choir.news to add a passkey, then sign in here with the passkey.
